notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I’m thrilled to announce update for the game, packed with new features and improvements based on your feedback.

Firstly, I’ve revamped the entire inventory system! It now features four distinct sections: Inventory, Frog Exchange, Currency Exchange, and Cosmetics. Managing your frogs has never been easier—now you can quickly skip from 1 to 50 frogs when selling, with a simple swipe. Plus, you’ll always see the total number of frogs you have, making trades smoother and more intuitive. The same changes apply to currency exchanges.

I’ve also unified all items into one inventory, allowing you to organize and group items of the same type into a single slot—or ungroup them if you prefer. To streamline your experience, you can now delete a single item or all items of that type in one go.

In the chests section, you’ll instantly see your total chest count. There’s now a handy skip button for the chest-opening animation, so you won’t need to wait the full 15 seconds to see what’s inside each chest—perfect for players eager to move forward quickly!

I’ve added a new Legendary Frog Exchange feature, allowing you to swap legendary frogs, making it easier to collect rare achievements and complete your legendary frog collection. Additionally, I’ve included a full tutorial that provides newcomers—and even experienced players—with guidance to help everyone understand all the game’s features more easily.

Localization is now available in 12 different languages, making the game more accessible and enjoyable for players worldwide. I hope this addition lets more players dive into the game with ease.

Cave mode has also seen some exciting updates! You can now continue to play after receiving your reward (limited to once every 24 hours). After defeating the boss, you can jump into the new Hard Mode. In this mode, enemies have double health and damage, and their spawn rate accelerates by 0.001 seconds every second, reaching up to four enemies per second. The maximum player level has also been raised to 60, and the boss will now respawn with increased health every 60 seconds, challenging even the most seasoned players. Please note, however, that there are no additional rewards for completing Hard Mode—it’s all about testing your skills!

Finally, I want to share a personal update: I’ll be stepping away from this game’s development. I’ve started working on a new, more ambitious project, and unfortunately, I won’t have time to dedicate to this game anymore. Although I couldn’t implement everything I had planned, I tried to prioritize the most requested features and improvements. Thank you all for your incredible support, feedback, and passion for the game. I hope these updates enhance your experience—enjoy, and happy gaming!

notes.title: The last chance!
notes.content: Hello everyone, there are only 10 days left to collect the Galaxy Frog and 14 days to collect the Demon Frog, after which these frogs will become exclusive and will never be available again, so I advise you to save up your coins and buy them. Good luck to you!

notes.title: Goodbye 15-second delay
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I’m releasing a new update right now. Finally, I’ve made changes to the 15-second system. Unfortunately, it won’t be possible to completely say goodbye to it, but the changes are quite significant, especially in exchanging frogs for coins and crystals, and in exchanging crystals for coins. Now, you can exchange up to 50 frogs at once, which saves an incredible amount of time: (50 * 15 = 750 seconds). Moreover, the 15-second menu will no longer cover the entire screen but will only appear on the frog you just sold. So, after selling, you won’t have to sit and wait—you can just exit and continue doing other things, and after 15 seconds, you’ll be able to exchange up to 50 frogs again at once. Additionally, the 15-second delay applies only to one type of frog, meaning you can continue exchanging other frogs during that time. This means that with just a few clicks, you can sell over 1000 frogs at once. The same system applies to exchanging coins for crystals, where you can now exchange 10x1 crystals up to 50 times in a single click, saving a lot of time.

For now, I haven’t touched the chests (For the new exchange system, I needed to write 12000+ lines in the file for trades) and decided to release just this update so that it’s already more convenient for you to play the game. Therefore, the next update will focus on the 15-second chest delay (if, of course, something can be done about it). In addition, I’ll be adding item deletion.

I can give you a few spoilers for future updates:
I plan to add text to the game to make it clearer what’s where. Plus, I’ll be adding a tutorial to explain how to play because it might not be very clear at first.
After all of this, there will be updates to the cave gameplay. I’m planning a very exciting update for you, so stay tuned!

Thank you so much for your support! Every day I read and look at the reviews for the game, and they inspire me even more to work hard and improve the game!

notes.title: CAVE UPDATE
notes.content:
In the latest update for Frogs, I'm introducing an exciting new feature: The Cave! This dark, mysterious area is filled with perilous challenges and hidden secrets. Deep within, players will encounter dangerous monsters, treacherous obstacles, and powerful crystals that must be destroyed to proceed. As you venture further, the intensity rises, with each level.

At the heart of the cave awaits the Boss Battle—an epic confrontation that will test your skills and determination. Defeating the boss earns you massive rewards . Rumors speak of ancient frog warriors who once sealed away powerful artifacts deep within the cave. Can you uncover these hidden treasures?

As you explore, you'll uncover more about the mysterious history of the cave, its connection to the world of Frogs, and the role your frogs play in the ancient battle for the realm. The deeper you go, the more the story unfolds, revealing long-forgotten legends and epic battles from the past.

Prepare your best frogs for the journey — epic battles, legendary rewards, and ancient lore await those brave enough to enter The Cave!

Other updates:

- Fixed the MLG Frog bug. Now, you can trade it for crystals and coins.
- Added more time to purchase Demon and Galaxy Frogs (very few players bought them) :(
- Crystals and Coins farms fixed: now the Coin Farm gives coins, and the Crystal Farm gives crystals (previously, it was reversed).
- Reduced the number of clicks required to get items from farms. It used to be around 800 clicks; now it's around 200.
- Fixed several UI issues.
- Adjusted chest drop chances. Previously, it was below 100%, making the chances VERY low. All drop rates have been increased, allowing you to farm more Epic, Mythic, and Legendary frogs.
- After spending 1-2 minutes in the game, you can receive 100 coins and 100 crystals for free (only once). This offer lasts until 20.09.2024.

GOOD LUCK!
